mood: Modern minimal SaaS. Clean, extreme whitespace, restrained color, authoritative but calm. 'Anti-default' look. The 'Monday.com' format elevated to a premium enterprise feel.

rules: H1 on marketing page must be text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-tight font-light
Use font-medium for standard headings, avoid defaulting to bold
Absolutely NO Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans
Section headers should be text-2xl to text-3xl tracking-tight
Table headers must be text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 font-semibold

spacing_and_layout.marketing: Use generous padding (py-24 or py-32). Grid based bento layouts with asymmetrical elements.
spacing_and_layout.app_shell: Left sidebar fixed (240px wide), 64px top nav. Background slate-50, content areas white.
spacing_and_layout.kanban: Subtle gray columns (bg-slate-50/50), white cards with shadow-sm and border-slate-200, minimal padding inside cards (p-3).
spacing_and_layout.general: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding. Nested radii: child <= parent.

components.tables: Customized Shadcn Table. NO outer card shadow. Use crisp borders. Status pills embedded in cells.
components.buttons: Shadcn Button. Override radius to rounded-md. Remove generic blue default focus rings, use ring-slate-900.
components.inputs: Shadcn Input. Focus rings should be ring-slate-900.
components.drawers: Shadcn Sheet/Drawer for detail views (Company/Contact/Deal). Width: sm:max-w-md or md:max-w-lg.
components.cards: Shadcn Card. Flatten shadows. Rely on 1px border-slate-200 for definition.
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs. Use clean underline styles or muted pills.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use ONLY JavaScript (.js/.jsx) for all frontend components. Do NOT use TypeScript (.ts/.tsx).
Install and configure Manrope (Headings) and IBM Plex Sans (Body) fonts via Google Fonts.
Build the marketing page first with the provided hero abstract image.
Implement JWT-based authentication (login/register) with standard Shadcn Forms.
Build the authenticated CRM shell (Left Sidebar + Top Nav). The shell should be extremely clean and minimal.
Develop the Dashboard utilizing Recharts for revenue KPIs and pipeline funnel.
Develop Companies & Contacts tables using Shadcn Table component. Include CSV import/export placeholders.
Develop the Deals view with a robust dual-toggle (Table View & Kanban Board View). Use dnd-kit for Kanban drag-and-drop.
Implement detail Drawers for Deals/Contacts using Shadcn Sheet. Include timeline of activities.
Develop the Automations Rule Builder UI (Trigger -> Condition -> Action visual builder).
Ensure ALL interactive elements have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
Seed rich mock data reflecting realistic B2B SaaS accounts, contacts, and deals.
Avoid typical blue/purple gradients and generic 'tech' aesthetics. Strictly follow the refined Slate/Emerald/Rose/Amber monochromatic palette.
